title: Construction Loans Product Eligibility Matrix and Builder Standards
content:
Each of the six Construction Loans products is open to a defined kind of member and project, finances a site of limited size, and converts on completion into a defined permanent loan. The matrix below is the product-level standard for who may apply, who may build and what protection must be in place during construction.

## 1. Entry requirements by product

| Product | Entry requirement | Largest commitment | Permanent financing |
|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | Owner-builder experience required | USD 400000 | Country Home loan |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | Approved builder required | USD 832750 | Country Home loan (one closing) |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | Approved builder required | USD 1500000 | Country Home loan (separate closing) |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | Approved builder required | USD 750000 | Country Home loan |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | The member's primary segment is farm operator | USD 2000000 | farm real estate loan |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | The member's primary segment is farm operator; an environmental permit is required; an integrator contract or a feasibility study is required | USD 6000000 | farm real estate loan |

## 2. Builder, insurance and site standards

| Product | Member may act as own general contractor | Builder must be on the approved builder list | Builder's risk insurance naming the association required during construction | Largest site financed with the building |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | Yes | No | Yes | 40 acres |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | No | Yes | Yes | 40 acres |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | No | Yes | Yes | 40 acres |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | No | Yes | Yes | 40 acres |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | Yes | No | Yes | 160 acres |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | No | Yes | Yes | 160 acres |

## 3. Definitions

- **Owner-builder allowed** — Boolean; whether the member may act as their own general contractor.
- **Approved builder required** — Boolean; whether the builder must be on the association's approved builder list.
- **Builder's risk insurance required** — Boolean; whether builder's risk insurance naming the association is required during construction.
- **Largest site** — Largest site financed with the building, acres.

## 4. Reading the matrix

- *Which Construction Loans products let the member be their own general contractor?* The Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan and the Farm Building Construction Loan; on the other four the member may not act as their own general contractor.
- *Which products require a builder from the approved builder list?* The Single-Close, Two-Close and Post-Frame Home Construction Loans and the Livestock Facility Construction Loan.
- *Is builder's risk insurance naming the association required on every product?* Yes; the table shows it as required during construction on all six.
- *How large a site may be financed?* Up to 40 acres with any of the four home construction products, and up to 160 acres with the Farm Building or Livestock Facility Construction Loan.
